description: This file contains Go source code for marshaling and unmarshaling JSON and CBOR data structures related to Kubernetes API extensions, including constants, types, and methods for JSON/CBOR serialization.

classes.name: JSONSchemaPropsOrBool
classes.description: Type representing either a JSON schema or a boolean allowing/disallowing schema application.

classes.name: JSONSchemaPropsOrStringArray
classes.description: Type representing either a JSON schema or an array of strings.

classes.name: JSONSchemaPropsOrArray
classes.description: Type representing either a JSON schema or an array of JSON schemas.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Type encapsulating raw JSON data with custom marshaling and unmarshaling logic.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON format.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into the object.

methods.name: MarshalCBOR
methods.description: Serializes the object to CBOR format.

methods.name: UnmarshalCBOR
methods.description: Deserializes CBOR data into the object.
